headline: Brightwell Foods cut freight overbilling by {m1_abs} and now audits every invoice before it is paid
challenge: Brightwell receives about 14,000 carrier invoices a month. One analyst sampled roughly 5% in spreadsheets, so most overcharges, from duplicate bills to wrong accessorials, were found after payment or not at all. By then many were outside the carriers' 180-day claims window, and the freight line kept growing faster than volume.
solution: Connected the TMS and carrier EDI feeds in 9 days with no consulting engagement.
Re-rates every invoice line against the signed contract before payment.
Flags errors for approvers and files disputes automatically, with evidence attached.
Gives the CFO a live savings and recovery dashboard.

results.label: reduction in annual freight overbilling ($1.9M to $1.1M)
audit coverage, from a 5% sample to 100% of invoices
reduction in invoice approval time, from 12 days to 3 days

quote.text: We used to find mistakes after the money was gone. Now they are fixed before the invoice reaches my desk.
quote.name: Marcus Lindqvist

cta.headline: See what your freight invoices are hiding
cta.body: Send us 90 days of carrier invoices and we will show you the overcharges, free, in 30 days.

footer: Fictional demo case study. Results are specific to this customer and may vary.
